rationale: `PendingAssessment` (src/authoring/mod.rs:188-194) is a plain data holder with `subject`, `record: Value`, `outcome` and `usage`. It is not a test. It does not implement persistence: it does not write evidence, choose file versus stdout, or set validation status. Those behaviors are in `impl[PendingAssessment]/fn[persisted]` and `AuthoringSubject::evidence_path`, which already carry `{impl}` references to this requirement. The struct holds the record and outcome that persistence later writes, so a change to the requirement could require changing its fields. `cite` is therefore the right role, and the struct has no `{impl}` or `{test}` reference to the same requirement, so the citation is not redundant.

text: After one valid judgment, the harness MUST write the subject text, submitted
determination and rationale, and recorded inputs using the existing evidence
By default, it MUST write the subject's evidence file. With `--stdout`, it MUST
emit a single evidence JSON object followed by a newline to stdout and MUST NOT
create or change evidence files or directories. All three outcomes MUST be
